title: Gateways, policy and an understandable system

questions.question: What is a gateway's primary value in an agent system?
options: It makes every system safe automatically
It can centralize observable cross-cutting controls
questions.explanation: Gateways can provide a consistent control point. They do not eliminate the need for sound architecture and service controls.

questions.question: What should you map before selecting a gateway product?
options: The effects to prevent and evidence to retain
The number of agents in a diagram
questions.explanation: Start from policy and operations requirements, then choose the smallest useful control surface.
